documents.title: Reset password
documents.content: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page and follow the emailed link to choose a new password. The link expires after 30 minutes.

documents.title: Enable two-factor authentication
documents.content: Go to Settings > Security and turn on two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the six-digit code to confirm.

documents.title: Lost two-factor device
documents.content: If you lost the phone with your authenticator app, use one of your saved backup codes to sign in, then set up two-factor authentication again from Settings > Security.

documents.title: Change email address
documents.content: You can change the email on your account under Settings > Profile. We send a confirmation link to the new address, and the change takes effect once you click it.

documents.title: Delete account
documents.content: To permanently delete your account and all of its data, go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Deletion cannot be undone.

documents.title: Refund policy
documents.content: Purchases can be refunded within 30 days if the product is unused. Contact billing to start a refund; it reaches your card in 5 to 10 business days.

documents.title: Cancel subscription
documents.content: You can cancel anytime from Billing > Subscription. You keep access until the end of the current billing period and are not charged again.

documents.title: Update payment method
documents.content: Add or replace your credit card under Billing > Payment methods. The new card is used for your next renewal.

documents.title: Download invoices
documents.content: Invoices for every payment are available under Billing > History as PDF files. You can add your company name and tax number before downloading.

documents.title: Shipping times
documents.content: Standard orders arrive within five business days. Express shipping takes two business days and is available for most countries.

documents.title: Track my order
documents.content: Once your order ships you get an email with a tracking number. Enter it on the carrier's website or in Orders > Track to see where your package is.

documents.title: International shipping
documents.content: We ship to over 40 countries. Customs duties and import taxes are charged by your country and are not included in the order total.

documents.title: Return an item
documents.content: Items can be returned within 30 days in their original packaging. Print the return label from Orders > Return and drop the parcel at any post office.

documents.title: Office hours
documents.content: Support is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm UTC. Messages sent outside these hours are answered the next business day.

documents.title: Contact support
documents.content: Email support@example.com or use the chat widget in the bottom corner of the app. Include your order number if your question is about an order.

documents.title: Supported browsers
documents.content: The app works in the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.

documents.title: Export my data
documents.content: You can download a copy of everything stored in your account as a ZIP file from Settings > Account > Export data. It is emailed to you within one hour.

documents.title: API rate limits
documents.content: The public API allows 100 requests per minute per API key. Requests over the limit get an HTTP 429 response and should be retried after the time in the Retry-After header.

documents.title: Data security
documents.content: All data is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest with AES-256. We run daily encrypted backups and never sell customer data.

documents.title: Team members and roles
documents.content: Account owners can invite teammates under Settings > Team. Admins can manage billing and members; members can only use the product.
